info.title: Queue OpenAPI for krea/v3/edit
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the krea/v3/edit queue.

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: Reference images to edit or combine (1-8). Order sets the <image-N> tags.

regional_edit.title: Regional Edit
regional_edit.description: With high or ultra reasoning, true preserves pixels outside the edit regions on the chosen canvas; false disables automatic region cropping and preservation. Omit to retain automatic preservation. With image_size=auto, keeps the canvas dimensions; an explicit image_size preserves the resized input. Billing uses the generated render dimensions. Use PNG for lossless output.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: Return images as data URIs instead of saving them in request history.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Check output images for unsafe content. Disabling requires account authorization.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: What to keep out of the image.

reasoning_level.title: Reasoning Level
reasoning_level.description: How much effort the prompt expander spends reasoning about the given editing task. Higher reasoning effort means slower generation time.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Bounding boxes on reference images, with optional labels and editing notes. Requires high or ultra reasoning.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Edit instruction. Refer to images as <image-1>, <image-2>, ... and regions as @label. May be omitted when a region has a note.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Latent noise seed. Use a new seed when editing a previous output again.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: Output size, rounded up to multiples of 16, at most 4,220,160 total pixels (1680×2512). auto lets the prompt expander pick the aspect ratio at about 2048×2048.

timings.title: Timings
timings.description: Seconds spent in each generation stage; `inference` is the total GPU sampling time.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt used for generation, after expansion.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Latent noise seed used for generation.

width.title: Width
width.description: Width as a fraction of image width.

height.title: Height
height.description: Height as a fraction of image height.

x.title: X
x.description: Left edge as a fraction of image width.

y.title: Y
y.description: Top edge as a fraction of image height.

label.title: Label
label.description: Refer to this region as @label. Defaults to its one-based position.

note.title: Note
note.description: Edit instruction for this region; may reference other @labels.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
